scientific.integrity: The proof uses exact barycentric constraints to force spanning-tree support, proves unique component-size cut weights and the converse, and computes dispersion independently from regular-simplex Gram coordinates and the tree cut identity. A standalone standard-library exact-rational program checks every labeled tree through six vertices and additional reproducible samples. These finite computations are supplementary, not substitutes for the all-dimensional proof. Relevant published primary full texts were materially compared for claim implication; residual indexing risks are retained.
limitations: Exact cardinality and tree structure concern only the vertex centroid and exactly \(n-1\) equal-weight points on simplex edges, for \(n\ge3\).
The affine bijection holds for any Euclidean simplex, but the stated squared-distance energy requires a regular simplex.
Existing Cayley tree enumeration and classical extremal Wiener index bounds are used as ingredients rather than claimed new.
An unindexed equivalent centroidal simplex construction or graphical-zonotope statement remains a historical originality risk.

title: Balanced edge configurations of simplices and the tree–Wiener energy identity
